metric_contract.representative_confidence: confidence of the earliest model-available raw box selected for the Telegram episode chart
metric_contract.episode_max_confidence: maximum raw-box confidence observed anywhere later or at the same time inside that already-defined episode

analysis_questions: How are earliest-visible confidence scores distributed?
How much does confidence rise after the earliest detection within an episode?
How many episodes remain and how much later do they appear under descriptive confidence cuts?
Is episode maximum confidence entangled with the number of repeated candidate windows?

null_control.method: permute confidence ranks across the 41 fixed episode candidate counts
null_control.purpose: test whether the observed confidence-versus-repeat relationship is stronger than random episode pairing

forbidden_claims_and_actions: No threshold is selected or recommended from this holdout surface
No Owner Gold, visual correctness, return, PnL or future label is read
No training, tuning, weight, label, ACTIVE/frozen, forward, deployment or order state changes
